nodes.label: Graphify query first rules
nodes.description: When graphify-out/graph.json exists run graphify query before the first grep or file read; use path and explain; use wiki index for navigation; GRAPH_REPORT only for broad review; run graphify update after code changes; big graph.json diffs in PRs are expected.
